prompt: Create an original 60 second neoclassical felt piano instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: felt piano, soft cello. Style: spacious broken chords, intimate close room. Tempo approximately 56 BPM; D major. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A melancholic and reflective piano melody, later joined by a string ensemble, creating a somber and emotional atmosphere.
description.zh: 忧郁而沉思的钢琴旋律，随后弦乐合奏加入，营造出一种悲伤而富有情感的氛围。
